Kerala Cabinet Approves Aid for Rain Death Victims

The Kerala Cabinet has announced financial assistance of Rs 8 lakh for the families of those who died in recent rain-related incidents. Nine people lost their lives, and one person is reported missing. Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan conveyed these details following a weekly Cabinet meeting.
